description: NaBa₃Gd₃Si₆O₂₀ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.77 Å. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.67-2.88 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-3.35 Å. There are two inequivalent Gd sites. In the first Gd site, Gd is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.56 Å. In the second Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.74 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.71 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.68 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Gd and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Gd, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ba and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Ba, two Gd, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Gd, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ba, one Gd, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Ba, two Gd, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing OBaGd₂Si tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Ba and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Gd, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Si atom.
